label: SCTP
notes: SCTP common header (RFC 9260 §3, formerly RFC 4960 §3.1) over IP protocol 132. The ports stay first-class number fields: libpcap's port primitives reach only TCP and UDP, so there is no sctp port primitive to emit (unlike the tcp/udp entries, where the encapsulation ports stay out). The 4-byte verification tag shields every chunk exchange against blind insertion, and the CRC32c checksum covers the whole packet including the pseudo-header. Chunks (DATA, INIT, INIT-ACK, HEARTBEAT...) follow as variable type-length-value structures at no fixed offset.

fields.label: Source Port
fields.description: Sending SCTP port; no sctp port primitive exists, so the port is a byte field.

fields.label: Destination Port
fields.description: Receiving SCTP port (common signalling points: 2905 M3UA, 3868 M2PA/SCTP).

fields.label: Verification Tag
fields.description: Tag the peer chose in its INIT/INIT-ACK; packets carrying a wrong tag are discarded. 0 for INIT chunks.

fields.label: Checksum
fields.description: CRC32c over the packet and the IPv4/IPv6 pseudo-header.
